## Raw second transcription

```yaml
```yaml
lines:
  - id: dependent.one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One person listed in the Dependents section"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dependent.one}

  - id: dependent.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  - id: dependent.h_rel_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, brother, sister, stepbrother, stepsister, half brother, half sister, or a descendant of any of them"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling_descendant"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_age_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: under age 19 at the end of 2025 and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly), or under age 24 at the end of 2025, a full-time student, and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly), or any age and permanently and totally disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.student_age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.student, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.disabled, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_residency
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lived with you for more than half of 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
    note: "The months input already applies the exceptions to time lived with you (temporary absences, birth, death, adoption, placement), so born_died, placed and part_year_home are not consulted separately. The kidnapped-child rule (Pub. 501) needs facts about the parts of the year before the kidnapping and after the return that the interface does not supply; it is not applied."

  - id: dependent.h_is_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: Do you have a child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.self_support, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_residency, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_contested
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The person meets the conditions to be a qualifying child of another person who is a taxpayer"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_claimant, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_nontaxpayer, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_tiebreak
    printed: "(gate)"
    label: "If the child meets the conditions to be a qualifying child of any other person for 2025, see Qualifying child of more than one person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_contested, {const: true}]}
    note: "The tiebreaker rules turn on parentage, time lived with each claimant and AGIs that the interface does not supply; a qualifying child who is also another taxpayer's qualifying child is refused."

  - id: dependent.h_qr_by_relation
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: relative who doesn't have to live with you (including, on a joint return, a relative of your spouse)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent_relative"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "in_law"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.spouse_relative, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr_rel
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: a qualifying relative is your relative, or any other person (other than your spouse) who lived with you all year as a member of your household if your relationship didn't violate local law"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_by_relation, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.qr_all_year, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.lawful, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_is_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: Does any person meet the conditions to be your qualifying relative?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, not: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qc, {const: true}]}}
        - {op: test, not: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_contested, {const: true}]}}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_rel, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.gross_income, {param: qr.gross_income_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.supported, {const: true}]}
    note: "The sheltered-workshop exception to the gross income test (Pub. 501) is not applied; gross income is taken as entered."

  - id: dependent.claimed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim this person as a dependent (Steps 1, 2 and 4)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qr, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.canada_mexico, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.married, dependent.multiple_support, dependent.h_tiebreak]
    note: "Step 2/4 question 4/5 (could you be claimed as a dependent) is read from sa.dependent and asked only when not filing jointly."

  - id: dependent.ctc_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3: You can claim the child tax credit for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: ctc.age_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.ctc_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.work_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.odc_person
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 3 and 5: You can claim the credit for other dependents for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, not: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}}

  - id: dependent.h_ctc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Schedule 8812 line 5: $2,200 per qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ctc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.ctc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812, line 5 (line 4 × $2,200)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_ctc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_odc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Schedule 8812 line 7: $500 per other dependent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: odc.per_dependent}

  - id: dependent.odc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812, line 7 (line 6 × $500)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_odc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_actc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Schedule 8812 line 16b: $1,700 per qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: actc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.actc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812, line 16b (number of qualifying children under age 17 with the required SSN × $1,700)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_actc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household Test 1: You paid over half the cost of keeping up a home that was the main home for all of 2025 of your parent whom you can claim as a dependent, except under a multiple support agreement"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.parent_home_paid, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household Test 2: a person who lived with you for more than half of the year and is a dependent you can claim (not one who is your dependent only because the person lived with you for all of 2025, nor one claimed under a multiple support agreement), or your unmarried qualifying child who isn't your dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qc, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_by_relation, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_residency, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.multiple_support, dependent.h_tiebreak]
    note: "The cost of keeping up the home is a household question (household.home_cost) and is not tested here. A married qualifying child (items 2 and 3) is refused through dependent.married."

  - id: dependent.hoh_absence
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Time this Test 2 person lived with you includes an absence from which it was not reasonable to assume the absent person would return, or during which you did not keep up the home"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.hoh_test2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: true}]}
    note: "Open whether the flag should stand for the absence alone; chosen: true only for a person who meets Test 2 and whose counted time includes such an absence (Pub. 501, Temporary absences)."

  - id: dependent.h_eic_base
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Step 3: relationship, age, joint return and residency (lived with you in the United States for more than half of 2025) tests"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:

        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.us_half, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_eic_contested
    printed: "(gate)"
    label: "The child meets the conditions to be a qualifying child of another taxpayer (Qualifying child of more than one person)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_eic_base, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_contested, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.eic_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This child meets the conditions to be your qualifying child for the purpose of claiming the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_eic_base, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.h_eic_contested]
    note: "A married child is a qualifying child only if you can claim the child as a dependent; married children are refused."

  - id: dependent.eic_ssn_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying child for the EIC who has a valid SSN issued on or before the due date of your return"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_under13
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 13 for part of 2025 when the care was provided"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, le: [dependent.age, {const: 12, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {const: 13, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_under13, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_over12
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Over age 12 at the time the care was provided"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, ge: [dependent.age, {const: 14, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {const: 13, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_over12_care, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.dc_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying person: a qualifying child under age 13 whom you can claim as a dependent, or a disabled person who wasn't physically or mentally able to care for themselves, lived with you for more than half the year and whom you can claim as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_is_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_under13, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_residency, {const: true}]}
    note: "A disabled person who would be your dependent except for gross income, a joint return, or your being claimable, and a custodial parent's child under the divorced-parents rule, are outside this per-entry test (handled by the Form 2441 screening gate f2441.nondependent)."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2c
    printed: "2(c)"
    label: "Check here if the qualifying person was over age 12 and was disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_over12, {const: true}]}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp

  - id: dependent.dc_line2d
    printed: "2(d)"
    label: "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025 for the person listed in column (a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.dc_paid}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp

  - id: dependent.h_cent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: sc.one_cent}

  - id: dependent.h_qp_cent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent if a qualifying person, otherwise zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_cent}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.dc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying persons this entry contributes to Form 2441 lines 3 and 27 (one qualifying person, or two or more)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: percent_floor, part: dependent.h_qp_cent, whole: {param: sc.hundred_cents}, cap: 1}
    note: "No atom turns a Bool into a Count; the 0/1 count is obtained as the whole-number percentage of 1 cent (or 0) over 100 cents."

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A dependent required to file an income tax return because their income meets the filing threshold"
    type: Bool
    expr:

        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}

    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 3: total adjustments (add lines 2a, 2b, and 2c)"

    printed: "(gate)"
    label: "Adjustments allocable to an academic period exceed that period's expenses (worksheet is completed per academic period)"
    type: Bool
    expr:

        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_has_adj, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_over, {const: true}]}

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "An education credit may be claimed for this dependent (qualified expenses paid, Form 1098-T requirement met, student TIN issued by the due date)"
    type: Bool
    expr:

        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_1098t, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lines 23 to 26 lead to lines 27 through 30 for this student, and the institution's EIN is provided"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_any, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line23, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line24, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line25, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line26, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_ein, {const: true}]}
    note: "Without the institution's EIN the American opportunity credit can't be claimed; chosen: the student then goes to line 31 (lifetime learning credit, which needs no EIN)."

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Go to line 31 for this student"
    type: Bool
    expr:

    type: NonNegDollars

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 4: subtract line 3 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_limited
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses, not more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [dependent.h_aoc_adjusted, dependent.h_aoc_cap]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_aoc_limited}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_band
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.full_band}

  - id: dependent.edu_line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_line27, take: dependent.h_band}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Multiply line 28 by 25% (0.25)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: dependent.edu_line28, rate: {param: aoc.second_rate}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_line29_plus
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add $2,000 to the amount on line 29"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_line29, dependent.h_band]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "If line 28 is zero, enter the amount from line 27. Otherwise, add $2,000 to the amount on line 29 and enter the result"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}, then: dependent.edu_line27}
        - {guard: {op: test, gt: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}, then: dependent.h_line29_plus}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_llc_adjusted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 4 (lifetime learning credit): tuition and required fees, including course materials required to be paid to the institution, less adjustments; if zero or less, -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_inst, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.edu_line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 31, on Part II, line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_llc_adjusted}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_llc
```
